why: Indexation has not moved at all: 6/25 on 2026-10-22, 6/25 on 2026-10-25, and the 6 are the homepage plus 5 August-dated news articles (crawled 2026-08-08 to 08-17). The four pages the product depends on — /bitcoin-500-day-cycle, /halving-dates, /simulator, /when-to-sell-bitcoin-after-halving — are all 'Crawled - currently not indexed' with last crawl 2026-10-22. Stage: crawled, declined. It is not on-page quality (canonical matches on all 25 URLs, 1,000-2,100 words each, original tables) and not internal linking (each of the 5 indexed articles already carries 4 links to the pillar, verified in live HTML). It is authority: 0 referring domains and 0 referral sessions give Google no external reason to index a four-month-old domain. Test: if the citation block, /data/500-day-cycles.json and two published owner posts have not produced a new referring domain or advanced the pillar's crawl date past 2026-10-22 by 2026-11-08, then only links at scale will move it and all on-page work should stop.

Non-brand clicks are 0 on 719 attributed non-brand impressions in 90 days. The two exact-intent queries are at position 9.1 (15 impressions) and 11.0 (5 impressions) — page 2, where CTR is roughly 1% — and the URL that answers them is not indexed, while the page that is indexed and carries 92 of 94 impressions (the homepage) ranks 56 and 63 for 'bitcoin 500' and 'btc 500'. Stage: impressions but no clicks, and the click is being asked of the wrong page. Test: date-first title, meta description and first 40 words on the pillar; if CTR on the cluster is still 0 at the same positions on 2026-11-01, the snippet is the problem, and if positions fall, the rewrite is.

Impressions fell 45 to 28 across 3 days, which is noise at this base — but the shape is the finding: 19 of 25 URLs cannot earn an impression at all, so the site has one visible page. The 5 indexed articles contribute 32 impressions at average positions 2.2-7.3 and 0 clicks in 28 days. This is downstream of indexation; there is no separate mandate, because a page-level fix is busywork until the pillar is indexed.

Sessions are not traffic and referrals do not exist: 19 sessions, 18 Direct + 1 Organic, 42.1% engagement, and no referral rows in GA4. GA4 exists only since 2026-10-23, but the 90-day GSC record says the same thing — no external signal. Stage: no links. Nothing has been distributed: outreach/ has held only README.txt since 2026-10-22 despite being backlog item #1, and this is the first review to issue an owner ask. Test: one X post plus one community comment, then GA4 referral sessions from x.com or reddit.com within 7 days; 0 means the channel or audience is wrong, not the number.

Input vs output does not balance. 28 commits since 2026-10-19 (12 on 10-22, 9 on 10-23, 2 on 10-24, 5 on 10-25), including 4 substantive product changes — the drawdown study, the entry-timing test, the live-date strip on 11 article pages, and removing the cycle score. Output over the same days: 0 new indexed URLs, 0 non-brand clicks, 0 referring domains, 0 referral sessions. Every one of those features landed on a URL Google had already crawled and declined on 2026-10-22. Four cycles, four features, zero results: the backlog order, not the craftsmanship, is what failed.

This review is reading a 4-day slice: results-history.csv starts 2026-10-22 and status-history.csv did not exist when the input was collected, so the signals' 'stalled 3d' understates a stall the 90-day report puts at 90+ days. The verdict does not depend on the short window — the 90-day data points the same way — but the next review will have both histories and must use them.

Measurement honesty: GSC's query dimension names only 5 of the 26 clicks in the last 28 days and 17 of 49 in 90 days. So 'zero non-brand clicks' describes the queries GSC will name, while 81% of last month's clicks have no query row at all; the true non-brand count is unknown, not proven zero. It is still not evidence of a single non-brand click, which is why the signal stays stalled.
questions: We put the only numbers no competitor publishes — the -83.7% drawdown and the entry-timing table — on a URL Google crawled and declined on 2026-10-22, and then added a third section to it. Why did no cycle ask whether that URL can rank before extending it again?
Outreach has been the #1 backlog item since 2026-10-22 and the folder still contains only a README. Why is the one task that can move indexation the one the automation keeps deferring?
21 of 26 clicks in 28 days have no query row in GSC. Are we reporting '0 non-brand clicks' as a measurement when it is a floor over 81% of clicks?

owner_asks.content:
The 500-day rule (buy 500 days before the halving, sell 500 days after) has 4 completed windows in my daily-close archive. Two things I did not expect when I checked:

- BTC closed below the T-500 entry price at least once before the halving in all 4. Median lowest close -11.7%; 2012 was -83.7%.
- Moving the entry 120 days earlier made the multiple worse in 3 of 3 windows (median -32.5%). Entry timing is not a knife-edge, but earlier was never better in this sample.

Method, tables and the timing test: https://btc500.net/bitcoin-500-day-cycle
